summary.description: One or two sentences for the hub listing.

canonical_repo.description: Loops refresh from here, never from a fork.

packages.description: Glob for result packages, e.g. research/*/.

transport.description: Where claims, findings and handoffs are posted. The reference board reader supports Discussions; issues are read by agents directly.

permissions.description: Ceiling on what a donated session may do. Never a grant: the donor's prompt and credentials still bound it.

verification_profile.description: Strongest kind of evidence the project can produce. Hub filter. The frontier record's claim_kind says what its current result claims.

hubs.description: Consent record: which hubs may list this project and what each may push. A specific hub overrides *. Push is never implied.

hub.description: The hub repository, OWNER/REPO, or * for all hubs.

list.description: Whether this hub may list the project.

credit.description: How contributors are credited. Disclosed, not graded; required for listing with a launcher.

process_changed_on.description: Last change to how the project coordinates or reviews; activity measurements count from here.

visual.description: The project's hero picture, on its card and page (spec §4, Visual). Optional: without one the hub draws a chart or a title card from the frontier.

render.description: image: a picture the project keeps. progress: the frontier's value over time. bound-gap: the same, against the proven bound and a baseline. records: the record table as a grid of cases, open and settled. The hub draws the last three from the frontier record.

kind.description: witness: the picture is the result itself (a packing, a ruler). derived: computed from the frontier (a chart). illustration: conveys the topic only. Defaults: derived for drawn renders, illustration for images.

src.description: image: path of an SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 1 MB.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for readers who can't see it. Required for images.

baseline.description: bound-gap: where the question started, e.g. the bound before the project.

prompt.description: image: the image-generation prompt it was made from, a template filled from the frontier: {title}, {statement}, {metric}, {value}. Shown beside the picture; regenerate the image when the frontier changes.

requirements.description: What a donor's machine needs (spec §4). Every key optional.

review.description: Review capacity, shown on the listing (spec §4, §12.2). Undeclared means no limit. Never a throttle: only `paused` closes the launcher.

per_week.description: Contributions the maintainers can give a first response to in a week, or "surge" for ready for any amount of traffic.

paused.description: Close the launcher until set back to false. The maintainer's switch for a backlog.

note.description: Who reviews, and anything donors should know.

mechanical.description: Contributions are accepted by a stated check, not by a person (spec §3.2, Review). The automated verdict counts as a first response.

rule.description: What passes, in plain words, e.g. "A PR that adds a row whose witness passes check_row and beats the table's value is merged automatically."

check.description: The workflow file or command that decides.

bots.description: GitHub logins whose comments carry the verdict, e.g. ["github-actions[bot]"].

picker.description: The project's own task picker, used instead of the protocol's draw (§7). Tools then pass the seed to it and never name a card themselves.

command.description: Argv, run from the repo root; "{seed}" is replaced by the seed.
